s0301.literal: An edict ordered the ten thousand palace guard troops Zheng Ding commanded back to the capital; Cui Bin and Ala Haiya to garrison jointly at Jingjiang; Hudutiemur and Zheng Ding jointly at E and Han; Jia Juzhen and Tobuqolotal jointly at Tanzhou.
s0301.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zheng Ding's ten thousand palace guard troops back to the capital; Cui Bin and Ala Haiya to garrison jointly at Jingjiang; Hudutiemur and Zheng Ding jointly at E and Han; Jia Juzhen and Tobuqolotal jointly at Tanzhou.

s0302.literal: On guisi day, the acting director of waterways was concurrently charged with grain transport affairs.
s0302.idiomatic: On guisi day the acting director of waterways was concurrently placed in charge of grain transport affairs.

s0303.literal: On jiawu day, for the merit of Zheng Ding's troops in pacifying Jingjiang, they were ordered to return home for brief rest, with appointment to go to Shangdu in the sixth month.
s0303.idiomatic: On jiawu day, for the merit of Zheng Ding's troops in pacifying Jingjiang, they were ordered home for brief rest, with orders to go to Shangdu in the sixth month.

s0304.literal: On yiwei day, Pu Shougang, Yin Defu, Li Jue, and Li Gongdu of Zhang and Quan prefectures in Fujian all surrendered their cities.
s0304.idiomatic: On yiwei day Pu Shougang, Yin Defu, Li Jue, and Li Gongdu of Fujian's Zhang and Quan prefectures all surrendered their cities.

s0305.literal: On dingyou day, thirty-two thousand two hundred six horses were requisitioned; mares with foals were returned to their owners.
s0305.idiomatic: On dingyou day 32,206 horses were requisitioned; mares with foals were returned to their owners.

s0306.literal: On renyin day, Xinfeng and other prefectures of Zhaoqing circuit in Guangdong all submitted.
s0306.idiomatic: On renyin day Xinfeng and other prefectures of Guangdong's Zhaoqing circuit all submitted.

s0307.literal: On guimao day, Zhang Zhigang of Shouchang prefecture was executed in the market for following the rebels.
s0307.idiomatic: On guimao day Zhang Zhigang of Shouchang prefecture was executed in the market for following the rebels.

s0308.literal: On yisi day, an edict ordered that gold and silver tallies worn by military and civilian officials inside and outside the capital be attached with colored cords at the shoulder and armpit, so as not to be profaned; this was fully made a regulation.
s0308.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered that gold and silver tallies worn by military and civilian officials inside and outside the capital be fastened with colored cords at the shoulder and armpit to prevent profanation; the rule was fully enacted.

s0309.literal: On gengxu day, Guo Zuan, assistant prefect of Jianning, surrendered the city.
s0309.idiomatic: On gengxu day Jianning assistant prefect Guo Zuan surrendered the city.

s0310.literal: Shi Sheng, a submitted official of Huangzhou, came to audience; for the battlefield achievements of Yu Yue and thirty-one other officers and commanders under him, they were ordered to receive offices.
s0310.idiomatic: Shi Sheng, a submitted official of Huangzhou, came to audience; for the battlefield achievements of Yu Yue and thirty-one other officers and commanders under him, they were ordered to receive offices.

s0311.literal: Zan Shun, associate director of the Eastern and Western Sichuan mobile privy council, said: "Recently we sent Zhao Mengxi, associate prefect of Longzhou, bearing an edict to summon and instruct the Duzhang and Luoji barbarians of Nanping Army and the four stockades of Fenghuang, Zhonglong, Luowei, and Gaoya—all submitted.
s0311.idiomatic: Zan Shun, associate director of the Eastern and Western Sichuan mobile privy council, said: "Recently we sent Zhao Mengxi, associate prefect of Longzhou, bearing an edict to summon and instruct the Duzhang and Luoji barbarians of Nanping Army and the four stockades of Fenghuang, Zhonglong, Luowei, and Gaoya—all submitted.

s0312.literal: The Tian and Yang families and the Zh'e barbarian people each also sent envoys to offer submission.
s0312.idiomatic: The Tian and Yang families and the Zh'e barbarian people each also sent envoys to offer submission.

s0313.literal: On renzi day, Shi Fu of Baoying army killed his garrison commander and submitted to the Huaidong commander-in-chief's headquarters; an edict made Fu a qianhu with a gold tally.
s0313.idiomatic: On renzi day Shi Fu of Baoying army killed his garrison commander and submitted to the Huaidong commander-in-chief's headquarters; an edict made Fu a qianhu with a gold tally.

s0314.literal: On guichou day, Wang Weizheng was ordered to transfer his garrison from Eastern Chuan to Gongchang.
s0314.idiomatic: On guichou day Wang Weizheng was ordered to transfer his garrison from Eastern Chuan to Gongchang.

s0315.literal: The mobile Central Secretariat, acting on commission, appointed submitted officials of Wen, Chu, Tai, Fu, Quan, Ting, Zhang, Jian, Jianning, Shaowu, Xinghua and other prefectures of Min-Zhe to each govern their own prefecture.
s0315.idiomatic: The mobile Central Secretariat, acting on commission, appointed submitted officials of Wen, Chu, Tai, Fu, Quan, Ting, Zhang, Jian, Jianning, Shaowu, Xinghua, and other Min-Zhe prefectures to each govern their own prefecture.

s0316.literal: The Tanzhou branch secretariat sent envoys memorializing: "Qingyuan, Yulin, Zhao, He, Teng, Wu, Rong, Bin, Liu, Xiang, Yong, Lian, Rong, Gui, and Xun in Guangnan West Circuit all submitted; one prefecture and fourteen subprefectures were obtained.
s0316.idiomatic: The Tanzhou branch secretariat sent envoys memorializing: "Qingyuan, Yulin, Zhao, He, Teng, Wu, Rong, Bin, Liu, Xiang, Yong, Lian, Rong, Gui, and Xun in Guangnan West Circuit all submitted; one prefecture and fourteen subprefectures were obtained.

s0317.literal: Xiangyang county of Xiangyang prefecture was re-established.
s0317.idiomatic: Xiangyang county of Xiangyang prefecture was re-established.

s0318.literal: Pacification commissioner and Zhexi circuit pacification commissioner Atahai was made pacification commissioner and placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs in Jianghuai;
s0318.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner and Zhexi circuit pacification commissioner Atahai was made pacification commissioner and placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs in Jianghuai;

s0319.literal: Prince Hede was made pacification commissioner and placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs in the Northern Capital.
s0319.idiomatic: Prince Hede was made pacification commissioner and placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs in the Northern Capital.

s0320.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiazi day: Song Temoda circuit generals Nong Shigui, Anping subprefecture prefect Li Weiping, Laian subprefecture prefect Cen Congyi and others, with one hundred forty-seven counties, subprefectures, and stream-caves under their jurisdiction and two hundred fifty-six thousand households, came to submit.
s0320.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jiazi day: Song Temoda circuit generals Nong Shigui, Anping subprefecture prefect Li Weiping, Laian subprefecture prefect Cen Congyi, and others, with 147 counties, subprefectures, and stream-caves under their jurisdiction and 256,000 households, came to submit.

s0321.literal: On guiyou day, circuit transport offices in all routes were abolished and their affairs merged into route headquarters.
s0321.idiomatic: On guiyou day circuit transport offices in all routes were abolished and their affairs merged into route headquarters.

s0322.literal: Four salt transport offices were established, and border markets were set up at Diaomen and Lizhou for trade with Tibet.
s0322.idiomatic: Four salt transport offices were established, and border markets were set up at Diaomen and Lizhou for trade with Tibet.

s0323.literal: On bingzi day, pacification commissioners Zhao Yu'ke and Chen Yan were summoned to audience.
s0323.idiomatic: On bingzi day pacification commissioners Zhao Yu'ke and Chen Yan were summoned to audience.

s0324.literal: On bingxu day, use of copper cash in Jiangnan was forbidden.
s0324.idiomatic: On bingxu day use of copper cash in Jiangnan was forbidden.

s0325.literal: Nanzhang county of Jun prefecture was re-established.
s0325.idiomatic: Nanzhang county of Jun prefecture was re-established.

s0326.literal: Fifth month, guisi day: the capital wine prohibition was strictly enforced; violators had their family property confiscated and distributed to the poor.
s0326.idiomatic: Fifth month, guisi day: the capital wine prohibition was strictly enforced; violators had their family property confiscated and distributed to the poor.

s0327.literal: On xinchou day, qianhu Halahasun died in the Battle of Hunduhai; his son Hududai'er was ordered to inherit the post.
s0327.idiomatic: On xinchou day qianhu Halahasun died in the Battle of Hunduhai; his son Hududai'er was ordered to inherit the post.

s0328.literal: On guimao day, the Guangnan West Circuit pacification commission was renamed a pacification commissioner's office; Qin and Heng subprefectures in Guangxi were reorganized as pacification commissions.
s0328.idiomatic: On guimao day the Guangnan West Circuit pacification commission was renamed a pacification commissioner's office; Qin and Heng subprefectures in Guangxi were reorganized as pacification commissions.

s0329.literal: Circuit censors and surveillance commissions in all circuits were additionally charged with promoting agriculture.
s0329.idiomatic: Circuit censors and surveillance commissions in all circuits were additionally charged with promoting agriculture.

s0330.literal: An edict ordered that submitted officials in Jiangnan of third rank and above send one hostage to serve at court.
s0330.idiomatic: An edict ordered that submitted officials in Jiangnan of third rank and above send one hostage to serve at court.

s0331.literal: Thirty-one clans of Western Tibetan chieftains including Alidingningzhan submitted, yielding forty thousand seven hundred households.
s0331.idiomatic: Thirty-one clans of Western Tibetan chieftains including Alidingningzhan submitted, yielding 40,700 households.

s0332.literal: On bingzi day, pacification commissioner Tan Chang of Rong prefecture plotted rebellion and was executed.
s0332.idiomatic: On bingzi day Rong prefecture pacification commissioner Tan Chang plotted rebellion and was executed.

s0333.literal: On xinhai day, because of flood and drought in Henan and Shandong, river-lake taxes were remitted and the people were allowed to fish freely.
s0333.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because of flood and drought in Henan and Shandong, river-lake taxes were remitted and the people were allowed to fish freely.

s0334.literal: On yimao day, Mongol and Han troops were selected to serve together as palace guards.
s0334.idiomatic: On yimao day Mongol and Han troops were selected to serve together as palace guards.

s0335.literal: An edict instructed pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian of Si prefecture.
s0335.idiomatic: An edict instructed Si prefecture pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian.

s0336.literal: Another edict instructed the Southwestern Barbarian King A Yong of Luzhou and the various barbarian tribes at Junlian, Tengchuan and elsewhere to come and submit.
s0336.idiomatic: Another edict instructed the Southwestern Barbarian King A Yong of Luzhou and the various barbarian tribes at Junlian, Tengchuan, and elsewhere to come and submit.

s0337.literal: Taoist master Li Dehe was ordered to substitute-worship at the Ji River.
s0337.idiomatic: Taoist master Li Dehe was ordered to substitute-worship at the Ji River.

s0338.literal: Sixth month, bingyin day: Yang Li, pacification commissioner of Fu prefecture, and his son Sirong successively submitted; Li was made pacification commissioner of Kuizhou circuit, Sirong army commander, both granted tiger tallies, and given one hundred ingots of notes besides.
s0338.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingyin day: Fu prefecture pacification commissioner Yang Li and his son Sirong successively submitted; Li was made Kuizhou circuit pacification commissioner, Sirong army commander, both granted tiger tallies, and given one hundred ingots of notes besides.

s0339.literal: On renyin day, families of those who died campaigning in Guang were rewarded with fifty taels of silver each.
s0339.idiomatic: On renyin day families of those who died campaigning in Guang were rewarded with fifty taels of silver each.

s0340.literal: On dingchou day, the Imperial Catering Directorate was established, rank third grade; Hulinsi of the Imperial Food and Medicine Bureau was made director; it had seven subordinate offices.
s0340.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Imperial Catering Directorate was established, rank third grade; Hulinsi of the Imperial Food and Medicine Bureau was made director; it had seven subordinate offices.

s0341.literal: On gengchen day, Yang Li's warriors were rewarded with one thousand ingots of notes.
s0341.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yang Li's warriors were rewarded with one thousand ingots of notes.

s0342.literal: On jiashen day, pacification commissioner Heide of Northern Jinghu circuit obtained spies reporting that Kuifu would dispatch troops to attack Jingnan.
s0342.idiomatic: On jiashen day Northern Jinghu circuit pacification commissioner Heide obtained spies reporting that Kuifu would dispatch troops to attack Jingnan.

s0343.literal: Yang Li and others were instructed to join forces with Tahai to repel them.
s0343.idiomatic: Yang Li and others were instructed to join forces with Tahai to repel them.

s0344.literal: On dinghai day, Chongming Sandbar was promoted to Chongming prefecture.
s0344.idiomatic: On dinghai day Chongming Sandbar was promoted to Chongming prefecture.

s0345.literal: Branch secretariat vice-minister and Jiangdong pacification commissioner Alahan was made left associate of the Central Secretariat and Jiangdong pacification commissioner; Hubei pacification commissioner Oljei was made vice-minister and Hubei pacification commissioner.
s0345.idiomatic: Branch secretariat vice-minister and Jiangdong pacification commissioner Alahan was made left associate of the Central Secretariat and Jiangdong pacification commissioner; Hubei pacification commissioner Oljei was made vice-minister and Hubei pacification commissioner.

s0346.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi new moon: note-printing offices at Daming and Jining were abolished.
s0346.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi new moon: note-printing offices at Daming and Jining were abolished.

s0347.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered that all thieves be executed in the market.
s0347.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered that all thieves be executed in the market.

s0348.literal: Secretary of tally seals Dong Wenzhong said: "Theft has degrees of force and stealth, and booty varies in amount—it seems hard to punish all alike under one law.
s0348.idiomatic: Secretary of tally seals Dong Wenzhong said: "Theft has degrees of force and stealth, and booty varies in amount—it seems hard to punish all alike under one law.

s0349.literal: The Emperor agreed and immediately ordered the measure stopped.
s0349.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and immediately ordered the measure stopped.

s0350.literal: On dingyou day, an edict ordered that henceforth only tally-bearing envoys and urgent military dispatches might use post-horses.
s0350.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered that henceforth only tally-bearing envoys and urgent military dispatches might use post-horses.

s0351.literal: On wuxu day, herds of sheep and horses north of the capital were strictly forbidden before the eighth month to be driven through northern passes to graze on capital-region grain; violators forfeited their livestock.
s0351.idiomatic: On wuxu day herds of sheep and horses north of the capital were strictly forbidden before the eighth month to be driven through northern passes to graze on capital-region grain; violators forfeited their livestock.

s0352.literal: On guimao day, Prince Shireki seized the Prince of North Ping at Alimali, shackled right chancellor Antong, and coerced princes into rebellion, sending friendly overtures to Haidu.
s0352.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince Shireki seized the Prince of North Ping at Alimali, shackled right chancellor Antong, and coerced princes into rebellion, sending friendly overtures to Haidu.

s0353.literal: Haidu refused; eastern-route princes also would not follow; he then led western-route princes to the north of Karakorum city.
s0353.idiomatic: Haidu refused; eastern-route princes also would not follow; he then led western-route princes to the north of Karakorum city.

s0354.literal: An edict ordered right chancellor Bayan to lead troops against him.
s0354.idiomatic: An edict ordered right chancellor Bayan to lead troops against him.

s0355.literal: Prince Oljei led his followers back to allegiance and joined Bayan's army.
s0355.idiomatic: Prince Oljei led his followers back to allegiance and joined Bayan's army.

s0356.literal: On bingwu day, a mobile censorate was established at Yangzhou, with commander-in-chief Xiangwei as censor-in-chief.
s0356.idiomatic: On bingwu day a mobile censorate was established at Yangzhou, with commander-in-chief Xiangwei as censor-in-chief.

s0357.literal: Eight circuit censor and surveillance commissions were established.
s0357.idiomatic: Eight circuit censor and surveillance commissions were established.

s0358.literal: On wushen day, Eastern Chuan commander-in-chief Zhang Derun and others attacked and took Fu prefecture, inflicting a great defeat and capturing pacification commissioners Cheng Cong and Cheng Guang.
s0358.idiomatic: On wushen day Eastern Chuan commander-in-chief Zhang Derun and others attacked and took Fu prefecture, inflicting a great defeat and capturing pacification commissioners Cheng Cong and Cheng Guang.

s0359.literal: A mobile Central Secretariat was established in Jiangxi; vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Tachu was made right associate, vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Maishuding left associate; Huaidong pacification commissioner Cherimtemur, Jiangdong pacification commissioner Zhang Rongshi, Jiangxi pacification commissioner Li Heng, campaign commissioner Yeshimishi, wanhu Shireimen, Jinghu circuit pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, and Min-Guang grand marshal and campaign commissioner Pu Shougeng were all made vice-ministers managing Jiangxi branch affairs.
s0359.idiomatic: A mobile Central Secretariat was established in Jiangxi; vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Tachu was made right associate, vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Maishuding left associate; Huaidong pacification commissioner Cherimtemur, Jiangdong pacification commissioner Zhang Rongshi, Jiangxi pacification commissioner Li Heng, campaign commissioner Yeshimishi, wanhu Shireimen, Jinghu circuit pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, and Min-Guang grand marshal and campaign commissioner Pu Shougeng were all made vice-ministers managing Jiangxi branch affairs.

s0360.literal: On renzi day, commercial taxes in the great capital were monopolized.
s0360.idiomatic: On renzi day commercial taxes in the great capital were monopolized.

s0361.literal: On dingsi day, the Hubei pacification commission mobilized troops to attack Mount Sikong and recovered Shouchang and Huangzhou.
s0361.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Hubei pacification commission mobilized troops to attack Mount Sikong and recovered Shouchang and Huangzhou.

s0362.literal: Song-campaign generals, soldiers, and Jianzhou troops who died in Guangxi were granted silver and notes in varying amounts.
s0362.idiomatic: Song-campaign generals, soldiers, and Jianzhou troops who died in Guangxi were granted silver and notes in varying amounts.

s0363.literal: The Sacred King of Broad Source at Huihuiwoyuan was given the additional title Well-Bestowing; the Spirit-Rescue Manifest-Responding King at Changshan given Broad Beneficence; the Spirit-Rain Marquis at Anqiu Haodao posthumously ennobled Spirit-Rain Duke.
s0363.idiomatic: The Sacred King of Broad Source at Huihuiwoyuan was given the additional title Well-Bestowing; the Spirit-Rescue Manifest-Responding King at Changshan given Broad Beneficence; the Spirit-Rain Marquis at Anqiu Haodao posthumously ennobled Spirit-Rain Duke.

s0364.literal: Vice-minister and Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made left associate of the Central Secretariat.
s0364.idiomatic: Vice-minister and Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made left associate of the Central Secretariat.

s0365.literal: Eighth month, wuwa new moon: an edict ordered Buhua to the Sichuan mobile privy council.
s0365.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuwa new moon: an edict ordered Buhua to the Sichuan mobile privy council.

s0366.literal: On dingmao day, the Chengdu circuit granary had collected five thousand shi surplus; the surveillance commission had already punished the offense; an order was given to distribute the grain to Western Chuan troops.
s0366.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Chengdu circuit granary had collected 5,000 shi surplus; the surveillance commission had already punished the offense; an order was given to distribute the grain to Western Chuan troops.

s0367.literal: On xinwei day, Lü Xiwen, prefect of Changde, and Li Sanjun plotted rebellion; when discovered, the branch secretariat was ordered to execute them.
s0367.idiomatic: On xinwei day Changde prefect Lü Xiwen and Li Sanjun plotted rebellion; when discovered, the branch secretariat was ordered to execute them.

s0368.literal: The imperial carriage hunted north of Shangdu.
s0368.idiomatic: The imperial carriage hunted north of Shangdu.

s0369.literal: Ninth month, renshen day: round iron gilt-hawk tallies were instituted.
s0369.idiomatic: Ninth month, renshen day: round iron gilt-hawk tallies were instituted.

s0370.literal: On bingshen day, Guang, Lian, Shao, Deqing, Hui, Chao, Nanxiong, Yingde and other prefectures of Eastern Guangnan all submitted inward.
s0370.idiomatic: On bingshen day Guang, Lian, Shao, Deqing, Hui, Chao, Nanxiong, Yingde, and other prefectures of Eastern Guangnan all submitted inward.

s0371.literal: On jiachen day, the Fujian branch secretariat, because the two Song princes were within its territory, mobilized commander-in-chief Mangwudai and campaign commissioner Gao Xing to lead troops against them.
s0371.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Fujian branch secretariat, because the two Song princes were within its territory, mobilized commander-in-chief Mangwudai and campaign commissioner Gao Xing to lead troops against them.

s0372.literal: Anger, Xindu, Tangudai and others led troops against Mount Sikong stockade, broke it, killed Zhang Dexing, and took his three sons back.
s0372.idiomatic: Anger, Xindu, Tangudai, and others led troops against Mount Sikong stockade, broke it, killed Zhang Dexing, and took his three sons back.

s0373.literal: On renzi day, Fujian pacification commissioner and acting Southern Campaign commander-in-chief Suodu sent campaign commissioners Baijianu and Ding Guang to take Chong'an county and other counties of Jianning and Nanjian subprefecture.
s0373.idiomatic: On renzi day Fujian pacification commissioner and acting Southern Campaign commander-in-chief Suodu sent campaign commissioners Baijianu and Ding Guang to take Chong'an county and other counties of Jianning and Nanjian subprefecture.

s0374.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0374.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, bingchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

s0375.literal: On jiwei day, offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0375.idiomatic: On jiwei day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0376.literal: On gengshen day, Hubei pacification commissioner Tahai extended his territory to Taiyuan Flat of Kuifu, captured its general, and executed him.
s0376.idiomatic: On gengshen day Hubei pacification commissioner Tahai extended his territory to Taiyuan Flat of Kuifu, captured its general, and executed him.

s0377.literal: On xinyou day, the hunting prohibition in Gaizhou was relaxed.
s0377.idiomatic: On xinyou day the hunting prohibition in Gaizhou was relaxed.

s0378.literal: On yihai day, because Song Zhang Shijie and Wen Tianxiang had still not submitted, Atahai was ordered to select crack troops to blockade the cities around Longxing.
s0378.idiomatic: On yihai day, because Song Zhang Shijie and Wen Tianxiang had still not submitted, Atahai was ordered to select crack troops to blockade the cities around Longxing.

s0379.literal: Unregistered troops following the great army in plundering were forbidden to cross passes and ferry points.
s0379.idiomatic: Unregistered troops following the great army in plundering were forbidden to cross passes and ferry points.

s0380.literal: On jimao day, submitted ministers Guo Xiao and Wei Xiangzu came to audience and were granted cloth and silk in varying amounts.
s0380.idiomatic: On jimao day submitted ministers Guo Xiao and Wei Xiangzu came to audience and were granted cloth and silk in varying amounts.

s0381.literal: On renwu day, a pacification commissioner's office was established at Huangzhou.
s0381.idiomatic: On renwu day a pacification commissioner's office was established at Huangzhou.

s0382.literal: On jiashen day, pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian of Bozhou said: "Our clan has held this land from Tang through Song, nearly five hundred years.
s0382.idiomatic: On jiashen day Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian said: "Our clan has held this land from Tang through Song, nearly five hundred years.

s0383.literal: Yesterday we received an imperial order permitting us to remain as before; we beg for a seal edict.
s0383.idiomatic: Yesterday we received an imperial order permitting us to remain as before; we beg for a seal edict.

s0385.literal: Branch secretariat vice-ministers Hudutemur, Tobuqolotal, and Cui Bin were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat; Ezhou headquarters darughachi Zhang Ding and Hubei pacification commissioner Jia Juzhen were made vice-ministers.
s0385.idiomatic: Branch secretariat vice-ministers Hudutemur, Tobuqolotal, and Cui Bin were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat; Ezhou headquarters darughachi Zhang Ding and Hubei pacification commissioner Jia Juzhen were made vice-ministers.

s0386.literal: Eleventh month, wuzi day: privy council officials reported: "Song Wen Tianxiang and his follower Zhao Mengyin rose together; the mobile Central Secretariat sent troops against them, killed Mengyin, and Tianxiang barely escaped with his life.
s0386.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuzi day: privy council officials reported: "Song Wen Tianxiang and his follower Zhao Mengyin rose together; the mobile Central Secretariat sent troops against them, killed Mengyin, and Tianxiang barely escaped with his life.

s0387.literal: An edict ordered his wife and children sent to the capital.
s0387.idiomatic: An edict ordered his wife and children sent to the capital.

s0388.literal: Right vice commander-in-chief Zhang Derun presented merit for Fu prefecture and was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0388.idiomatic: Right vice commander-in-chief Zhang Derun presented merit for Fu prefecture and was granted one thousand ingots of notes.

s0389.literal: On yiwei day, all who forged treasure notes, including accomplices, were to be executed; those who shared in using them received reduced death by beating; fully enacted as regulation.
s0389.idiomatic: On yiwei day all who forged treasure notes, including accomplices, were to be executed; those who shared in using them received reduced death by beating; fully enacted as regulation.

s0390.literal: On gengzi day, the Central Secretariat was ordered to proclaim throughout: with Jiangnan pacified, Song should be called Defunct Song, and the mobile court called Hangzhou.
s0390.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Central Secretariat was ordered to proclaim throughout: with Jiangnan pacified, Song should be called Defunct Song, and the mobile court called Hangzhou.

s0391.literal: Minister of Personnel Bedruddin was made vice-minister.
s0391.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Bedruddin was made vice-minister.

s0392.literal: Twelfth month, bingchen day: relay stations at Zhongluan, Tangcun, and Qimen were established.
s0392.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingchen day: relay stations at Zhongluan, Tangcun, and Qimen were established.

s0393.literal: On dingmao day, because prices in the great capital were soaring, ten thousand shi from government granaries were released to sell relief grain to the poor.
s0393.idiomatic: On dingmao day, because prices in the great capital were soaring, ten thousand shi from government granaries were released to sell relief grain to the poor.

s0394.literal: On gengwu day, Yuan Shi'an of Liangshan army surrendered his city and the people and soldiers of Jinshi city.
s0394.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yuan Shi'an of Liangshan army surrendered his city and the people and soldiers of Jinshi city.

s0395.literal: On renshen day, the Tanzhou branch secretariat re-established Qiyang county.
s0395.idiomatic: On renshen day the Tanzhou branch secretariat re-established Qiyang county.

s0396.literal: Bandit leader Luo Fei was beheaded and the remaining followers were entirely pacified.
s0396.idiomatic: Bandit leader Luo Fei was beheaded and the remaining followers were entirely pacified.

s0397.literal: On yihai day, commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an attacked Xianchun prefecture and took it.
s0397.idiomatic: On yihai day commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an attacked Xianchun prefecture and took it.

s0398.literal: The calendar for the fifteenth year was granted to Goryeo.
s0398.idiomatic: The calendar for the fifteenth year was granted to Goryeo.

s0399.literal: Secretariat deliberator Geng Ren was made vice-minister.
s0399.idiomatic: Secretariat deliberator Geng Ren was made vice-minister.

s0400.literal: Because of flooding at Guan prefecture and Yongnian county, this year's land tax was remitted.
s0400.idiomatic: Because of flooding at Guan prefecture and Yongnian county, this year's land tax was remitted.
